messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Runtime KV cardinality spike detected; pool=dedicated-eu-west-1, kv_keys=1.05M (+700k/6m), p50_token_latency=220ms
maria.s: I'm taking this one. seeing rapid prompt/prefix churn on the dashboard. tagging @oncall. :mag:
kevin: pulling recent deploys and batching config history now. any CS noise?
sana: jules-cs, any customer hits?
jules-cs: got two tickets from NorthParcel and BrightCart reporting high tail latencies and partial outputs. escalating to priorities.
dan-eng: quick correl: a config change at 03:12 increased continuous_batching.max_tokens to 4096 and max_batch_tokens to 8k. also tokenizer bumped from v2.1 -> v2.2 in runtime image at 03:09. both within same deploy window.
maria.s: that combo can cause promptkey regeneration — tokenizer produced different prefix encodings so cache keys exploded.
kevin: confirmed: tokenizer diffs show whitespace normalization changes and different control char handling; same prompt templates now yield distinct prefix hashes.
sana: customers seeing truncated responses because cache miss leads to longer decoding budgets and occasional timeouts?
dan-eng: yep. also KV write pressure causing compaction pauses on the KV tier -> added latency.
maria.s: mitigation plan prioritized: 1) cap batching to pre-deploy values; 2) enable routing fallback to older model variant where possible; 3) targeted TTL reduction for noisy prefixes; 4) hold full tokenizer promotion until migration path exists.
kevin: rolling config rollback for batching limits. patch call:
```
PATCH /v1/runtime/configs/dedicated-eu-west-1
{"continuous_batching":{"max_tokens":2048,"max_batch_size":64}}
```
ops-bot: config rollout started by kevin at 2126012401
maria.s: do NOT scrub prefixes until we see effect of batching cap — we want to avoid accidental data loss.
kevin: rollback finished at 2126012428. enabling batch backpressure and draining inflight.
maria.s: telemetry: kv writes down ~55% in 40s, p50 latency down to ~110ms, error rate 0.9%.
jules-cs: NorthParcel reports improvement; BrightCart still seeing occasional 502s on long prompts.
dan-eng: next: identify hot keys caused by tokenizer diff. generating list of top writers:
```
rwd-kvctl top-keys --pool dedicated-eu-west-1 --metric=write_rate --limit=1000 > /tmp/hot_prefixes.txt
```
kevin: will run a dry-run scrub against that list first.
tina-oncall: I'll run dry-run and share sample for CS to verify no customer-critical templates are affected. executing dry-run now.
ops-bot: scrub dry-run completed at 2126012550 — found ~36k high-write prefixes tagged tokenizer-v2.2 fingerprint.
maria.s: good. Tina, perform targeted TTL reduce to 120s for those keys (conservative) and monitor error budget.
tina-oncall: launching targeted TTL update:
```
rwd-kvctl scrub --pool dedicated-eu-west-1 --key-file /tmp/hot_prefixes.txt --set-ttl=120
```
ops-bot: scrub started at 2126012582
kevin: adding temporary routing rule to fall back to lama-v1 for requests with prefix_hash_version!=v1 to reduce cache reliance where possible.
maria.s: keep CS updated. also add a short-circuit guard: if request token budget > 8000 then fail-fast to avoid hogging resources.
dan-eng: implemented guard in the runtime config; compiled and rolling at 2126012620.
jules-cs: BrightCart reports reduced errors and improved tail latency. NorthParcel fully recovered.
sana: any customer data exposure? security?
jules-cs: no PII leakage reported — only availability degradation.
maria.s: metrics look stable: kv writes near baseline, error rate 0.15%, p50 ~90ms.
tina-oncall: scrub finished at 2126012668 — removed ~31k noisy prefixes and left migration note + diff in runbook.
ops-bot: incident resolved by maria.s at 2126012670
maria.s: short postmortem notes: root cause = tokenizer change + simultaneous aggressive continuous-batching increase -> sudden prefix key cardinality regen -> KV write blowout -> perf cliff impacting customers.
action items (owners):
- pin tokenizer versions across runtime deploys until rehash migration exists (owner: eng-ml)
- add predeploy promptkey stability test for tokenizer changes (owner: eng-runtime)
- automated alert for prefix-cardinality delta > 40% in 5m (owner: eng-sre)
- batching config canaries and rollout safeguards (owner: eng-platform)
- CS customer comms draft for NorthParcel & BrightCart (owner: jules-cs)

maria.s: thanks all — filing full postmortem and assigning follow-ups. :pray:
